reviews.title: Read and write like never before!
reviews.comment:
Do you like storage? Read and write speeds are awesome for this storage device. This is used for all of my major storage. I have a different one for OS and program files.

Don't waste your money if your motherboard cannot support a GEN 5 NVMe!

You won't get the speeds if your motherboard supports only gen 4.
